capabilities: Render Markdown notes as mind maps in six layouts (mind map, logical, organization, catalog, timeline, fishbone)
Edit nodes in the map and write changes back to the Markdown file verbatim
Add wikilinks, images, tasks, tags, relationships and summaries on nodes
Embed read-only mind maps in notes via a fenced mindmap code block
Export maps as PNG or SVG images
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux) and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. A one-shot migration rewrites legacy frontmatter keys; explicit section documents deliberate differences from Obsidian's own interactions and confirms no telemetry or outbound network requests.
problem: Obsidian shows notes only as text or preview, so there is no way to view and edit a note's outline directly as a mind map.

relations.evidence: Powered by the simple-mind-map engine · by WinterMosquito

summary: Mind-map view and editor that renders Markdown notes as six-layout mind maps and writes every edit back losslessly into the same file.
